title: docs(openspec): plan #3410 Refuse a negative search that proves nothing
summary: The plan of this case is the merged plan of pull request #3435, with the replay task that the stage job asks since #3331. Its group 4 adds the case of a move of the stage modules and changes only fixture files and a test file, and it delivers its criterion: group 3 adds the `search_evidence` field to `CaseFacts` before it. It has no known defect.
notes: Group 3, which adds the `search_evidence` field, is the group that the twin lacks.

The merged plan came before the rule of #3331. The last group has the added task to run `uv run devops roadmap eval stage --replay` with the score before and after, so that the gate `paths` accepts the plan. The twin has the same task.
The scores are set by hand. No review scored this plan.
